assignment: (p) source path is the vault file itself (self-move row); (q) ledger path is a symlink; (r) target path containing newline

key_findings.finding: A ledger row whose vault_path equals its own source_path yields SAFE(moved-to-obsidian). Removing the target deletes the only copy. Same for directories.
A vault_path that is a symlink alias or a ../-spelling of the source also yields SAFE; the alias dangles after removal.
A receipt whose vault copy is nested inside the source directory yields SAFE for the directory; removing the source destroys its own vault copy.

A symlinked ledger (direct, chain, or absolute external) is followed silently; the receipt evidence names no ledger path, so the receipt cannot be traced to a ledger file. Dangling /dev/null / directory ledgers are refused.
key_findings.evidence: cases Q1, Q2, Q4b, Q3, Q4, Q4c

key_findings.finding: Under a ledger-symlink swap race the verdict flips between SAFE and NOT-SAFE (49/51 over 100 runs): the receipt follows whatever target is live at read time; no pinning.
A target path containing a newline breaks the TSV record across two physical lines: path and verdict attribution shift for any line-oriented consumer. --json mode escapes correctly.

A newline-named scratch file can never receive SAFE(stale): the live-refs sweep calls rg with the basename and rg rejects a literal newline in the pattern (live-refs=unknown). Safe-side, but the stale receipt is unreachable for such names.

limitations: The live default ledger path could not be swapped for a symlink (read-only constraint on the real vault/lane surfaces); the q family exercises the same code through SOUJI_LEDGER, the tool documented override.
Q6 is timing-dependent evidence, not a determinism proof; each observed verdict is consistent with some symlink state.

The p-family oracle is the removal-safety rule: a moved-to-obsidian receipt must name a distinct copy that survives removal of the target. Self-move, alias, and nested rows are rejected as receipts by this seat.
The 2026-10-18 manual probe (control SAFE, self-move SAFE) was reproduced by this harness run; the harness is the evidence of record.
